text: おせっかいで　ごめんなさいね　あなたが　いもうとに　にていたから…

structure.jp: あなたが　いもうとに　にていたから…
structure.en: because you looked like my little sister...

patterns.name: 〜から (reason)
patterns.explanation: から after a statement means 'because'; ending on it gives the reason for what was just said. にていたから = 'because you looked like her'.

patterns.name: 〜に似ている
patterns.span: いもうとに　にていた
patterns.explanation: The person someone looks like takes に, and the verb is used in its ている shape. いもうとに　にていた = 'looked like my little sister'.

patterns.name: 〜で (reason)
patterns.span: おせっかいで　ごめんなさい
patterns.explanation: で before an apology tells you what the apology is for. おせっかいで　ごめんなさい = 'sorry for being nosy'.
